desc: Formalize the DP states: rooted tree, dp[u][k][h] = max vertices of selected connected set in u's subtree including u, with exactly k selected children, h = degree-4 vertex among descendants; usability: as child (parent selected) requires k∈{0,3}; as highest node (parent not selected) requires k∈{1,4}.

Derive transitions: bounded knapsack over children (count ≤4), child include options inc0 = dp[child][0][0] (child degree 1, no degree-4 below), inc1 = max(dp[child][0][1], dp[child][3][0], dp[child][3][1]) (degree-4 exists at/below child); exclude child = 0.
Answer rule: highest node u with parent unselected: k=4 valid regardless of h (u itself degree 4), k=1 requires h=1; ans = max(dp[u][1][1], dp[u][4][0], dp[u][4][1]) over all u; -1 if none.
Validate DP on Sample 1 by hand: obtained 8 (node 1 with child 2 in state k=3,h=1 contributing 7); Sample 2 yields -1 (max degree 3, no k=3/4 states).

Implement final Python code: fast I/O via sys.stdin.buffer, iterative DFS from root 1 to get parent/order, process nodes in reverse order, per-node 5x2 DP arrays with NEG = -10**9 sentinel, O(N·5·2·4) total work.
Write code block with delimiters, double-check edge cases (N=1 → -1, star K1,4 → 5, paths → -1, high-degree vertices choose exactly 4 children or 3+parent).
